itens.trecho: Um filme mais adulto do que seria desejável, onde a Pixar insiste em dar palco a personagens secundárias sem piada. A franquia “Carros” foi um dos grandes êxitos que a Pixar aproveitou de forma magistral, tanto para fins comerciais quanto para cimentar o seu estatuto cimeiro no campo da animação digital.

A film more adult than would be desirable, where Pixar insists on giving the stage to funnyless secondary characters. The “Cars” franchise was one of the great successes that Pixar masterfully capitalized on, both for commercial purposes and to cement its top status in the field of digital animation.

You know, I think I preferred this to the original. This time, the eager young "Lightning McQueen" is goaded by Italian champ "Francesco" into taking part in the inaugural "World Grand Prix". This has been set up by reformed oil gazillionaire "Sir Miles" who insists that the cars must use environmentally friendly, oil-free, fuel to compete.
